periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical orientation, approximately 85 degrees relative to the snout-ear horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape with a high vertical height-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering where the lower hemisphere of the patch is narrower than the upper.
